Looking at the verification errors, the issue is in the `else` branch of `HelperA.dfy`. The lemma needs to recursively call itself on the tail sequences to establish the inductive case.

Let me analyze the structure:
1. When `|s| == 0`, we use `A.Empty(s,t)` - this works
2. When `|s| > 0`, we need to:
   - Unfold the Weave definition using `O.Unfold(s,t)`
   - Recursively prove the property for the tails using `Prove(s[1..], t[1..])`
   - Use `A.Project` to connect the pieces

The missing piece is the recursive call `Prove(s[1..], t[1..])` which establishes:
- `K.Left(K.Weave(s[1..],t[1..])) == s[1..]`
- `K.Right(K.Weave(s[1..],t[1..])) == t[1..]`

Then `A.Project(s[0], t[0], K.Weave(s[1..],t[1..]))` gives us:
- `K.Left([s[0],t[0]] + K.Weave(s[1..],t[1..])) == [s[0]] + K.Left(K.Weave(s[1..],t[1..]))`
- `K.Right([s[0],t[0]] + K.Weave(s[1..],t[1..])) == [t[0]] + K.Right(K.Weave(s[1..],t[1..]))`

Combined with `O.Unfold` which shows `K.Weave(s,t) == [s[0],t[0]] + K.Weave(s[1..],t[1..])`, this should complete the proof.

```json
{
  "HelperA.dfy": "if |s| == 0 {\n      A.Empty(s,t);\n    } else {\n      O.Unfold(s,t);\n      Prove(s[1..], t[1..]);\n      A.Project(s[0], t[0], K.Weave(s[1..], t[1..]));\n      assert s == [s[0]] + s[1..];\n      assert t == [t[0]] + t[1..];\n    }"
}
```
